Revealed during the 'Realms Deep 2020' stream, Brutal Fate is the latest creation of modder Marcos Abenante better known in the gaming community as 'Sergeant_Mark_IV'. Marcos is the man behind the highly popular 'Brutal Doom' mod that has been around for a solid decade. Brutal Fate is described as a fast-paced, ultra-violent first person shooter, inspired by the sci-fi films from the 80s and 90s that also stays true to the much loved 'Doom' formula. The game will be running on the GZDoom engine, which itself is an improved source-port of the 'idTech 1' engine (the original Doom and Doom 2 engine). As a result the game will require a mere 400 MB of free hard drive space. Brutal Fate will be releasing on PC and will be entering Steam 'early access' sometime in the January of 2021.
